metadata.source: FirstRateData SPX_full_1min + SPX_full_1day historical index dataset

definitions.opening_zone_cohort: Days whose 09:30 RTH open price, expressed as ATR offset from previous close, falls in [lower_atr, upper_atr). Denominator includes all such sessions.
definitions.primary_boundary: The first boundary (upper or lower rung of the opening zone) whose price is spanned by a 3-minute bar's range.
definitions.primary_first_test_view: v1 is a day-level primary-first-test explorer. Upper/lower cards show sessions where that adjacent boundary was the first tested level. Percentages are rendered against the full opening-zone cohort unless explicitly labeled as subset percentages.
definitions.attempt: A contiguous-touch sequence counts as one attempt. A new attempt begins when a non-touching bar precedes the next touch.
definitions.close_side_upper: Touch-bar close >= U_price -> above (accepted). close < U_price -> below (rejected).
definitions.close_side_lower: Touch-bar close <= L_price -> below (accepted). close > L_price -> above (rejected).
definitions.acceptance_caveat: Acceptance is defined as the touch bar's own close landing on the through-side. Sustained acceptance (held for multiple bars) is NOT modelled in v1.
definitions.opposite_boundary_terminated: Primary boundary had >=0 rejections; opposite boundary was touched for the first time before primary was accepted.
definitions.ambiguous: A single 3-minute bar's range spans both the upper and lower rung simultaneously.
definitions.untouched: Neither boundary was touched by the 15:57 close.
definitions.touched_unresolved_by_close: Primary boundary was touched and rejected but not accepted before the 15:57 session close.
definitions.outcome_partition: For each zone, the 7 buckets (accepted_on_1, accepted_on_2, accepted_on_3plus, opposite_boundary_terminated, ambiguous, untouched, touched_unresolved_by_close) sum to n.
definitions.current_state_v2: Current-state mode goes beyond the open: choose hour of day, current ATR residence zone, and current level-interaction state, then see the next adjacent boundary event probabilities. This is an hourly snapshot model, not a trade recommendation.

definitions.current_state_denominator: All historical hourly snapshots matching the selected hour, current ATR residence zone, and current adjacent-level interaction state. Each session contributes at most one snapshot for that hour.
definitions.current_zone: The ATR zone containing the snapshot bar close. Price resides in zones between adjacent public Saty ATR levels.
definitions.level_state: Whether the snapshot bar is merely residing inside the zone or is touching the upper boundary, lower boundary, or both boundaries. Levels are boundary events, not residence states.
definitions.next_state_change: First adjacent boundary-level touch after the snapshot. Upper/lower accepted means the touch-bar close landed through the level; rejected means the touch-bar close landed back inside the current zone.

definitions.denominator: All historical sessions whose starting price is in the selected ATR residence zone at the start of the window. Window 1 (Open → 10am) uses the 09:30 RTH open price's zone to match the existing opening-zone cohort; windows 2-7 use the close of the first 3-min bar at/after the window start. Each session contributes at most one snapshot per window.
definitions.tested: A 3-min bar within the window has a range that touches/spans the adjacent ATR boundary level (bar high >= level AND bar low <= level).
definitions.accepted_up: The FIRST 3-min bar within the window that tests the upper adjacent boundary closes above that boundary (close > upper level price).
definitions.accepted_down: The FIRST 3-min bar within the window that tests the lower adjacent boundary closes below that boundary (close < lower level price).
definitions.independent_rates: The four displayed rates (tested up, tested down, accepted up, accepted down) are INDEPENDENT rates over the same starting-zone denominator. A single session can test BOTH boundaries, so tested_up + tested_down typically exceeds n. accepted_up + accepted_down does NOT equal 'sessions that left the zone'.
definitions.rejected_up: tested_up - accepted_up. A session whose first up-test bar's close landed BACK INSIDE the zone (close <= upper level).
definitions.rejected_down: tested_down - accepted_down. A session whose first down-test bar's close landed back inside the zone (close >= lower level).
definitions.tested_either: Sessions where at least one boundary was tested in the window.
definitions.tested_both: Sessions where BOTH boundaries were tested at some point in the window.
definitions.first_resolution: Mutually exclusive partition over n. For each session, the FIRST bar in the window that touches either boundary determines the bucket: first_upper_accept (touched upper only, close > U), first_upper_reject (touched upper only, close <= U), first_lower_accept (touched lower only, close < L), first_lower_reject (touched lower only, close >= L), first_both_same_bar (single bar touched both rungs), no_touch (no boundary touched in window). Buckets sum to n.
definitions.scope: Within-window only. Bars at or after the window end are ignored. Acceptance/rejection refer to single-bar close polarity at the first test; sustained acceptance is deliberately not modelled here.
